title: Decathlon Run 2026 Review: 9th Anniversary Run at SM Mall of Asia
seo_title: Decathlon Run 2026 Review | SM MOA Pasay, Philippines
meta_description: Decathlon Run 2026 review: August 30 at SM Mall of Asia, Pasay -- Decathlon Philippines' 9th Anniversary Run, expecting around 8,000 runners.
dek: Set for 30 August 2026 at the SM Mall of Asia Complex in Pasay, this is Decathlon Philippines' 9th Anniversary Run -- a 3am gun start for 5K, 10K and 21K categories, expected to draw around 8,000 runners.
verdict: The Decathlon Run is billed as Decathlon Philippines' 9th Anniversary Run, expected to pull around 8,000 runners to the SM Mall of Asia Complex -- the largest shopping mall in the Philippines and a well-known Manila Bay-side venue with straightforward access and infrastructure. A 3am gun start with an ambulance sweep from 7am is standard RunRio-series logistics, as are the strict 15-minute flag-off rule and the non-transferable, non-refundable registration terms. It's a large, reliably organised community race rather than a scenic or unusual one -- the appeal is scale and a familiar, easy-to-reach venue, not novelty.

sections.heading: A 9th Anniversary Run at the Philippines' Largest Mall
paragraphs: This is billed as the Decathlon Philippines 9th Anniversary Run, expected to draw around 8,000 runners to the SM MOA Complex in Pasay. [1] SM Mall of Asia sits within a reclaimed area along Manila Bay at the southern terminus of EDSA and is the largest shopping mall in the Philippines by floor area -- a venue built to handle large crowds and events, which suits a race of this scale. [2]

sections.heading: Three Distances, Early Start
paragraphs: Distances offered are 5KM, 10KM, and 21KM, all starting at Ocean Drive corner Seaside Blvd. [1] Gun start is early morning at 3:00am, with a course sweep by ambulance beginning at 7:00am to collect remaining participants -- standard timing for a large-field RunRio-organised event held before the day's heat builds.

sections.heading: Strict Race-Day Rules
paragraphs: Participants must start within 15 minutes of their category's flag-off time or be disqualified with no official result issued. [1] Registration is non-transferable and non-refundable, and there's no on-site registration or race-day kit claiming -- kits must be collected during the scheduled pre-race period. Wheelchairs, bikes, skates and strollers are not permitted on course, and organisers state they aren't liable for lost or damaged items left at baggage tents.

sections.heading: Protests and Practical Notes
paragraphs: Result protests must be filed in writing within one hour of results being posted and require a ₱5,000 fee -- consistent with the terms used across other RunRio-brand events in this research batch. [1] These are firmly community-race logistics: straightforward, well-tested, and unforgiving of last-minute changes.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a large, easy-to-reach race at a landmark Manila venue with reliable RunRio-standard organisation, the Decathlon Run's 9th Anniversary edition on 30 August 2026 delivers exactly that. It's not a scenic or unusual course, but for runners who value convenience and scale over novelty, it's a solid choice -- just collect your kit in advance and start on time.
